name: webinar-signup
title: Webinar signup
description: Register for a live session: the date in the viewer's own time zone, the speakers, what you will learn and a two-field form.
docs: Pass the event (title, startsAt, duration in minutes and the timeZone it is announced in), the speakers (a name, a role and an optional image; initials show until it loads), what the reader will learn, and onSubmit, which receives the name, the email and whether they want the recording, and may be async: resolve to confirm, reject to show the error and keep everything typed. The date and time are written in the announced time zone with its name, and after mount the reader's own time follows (Your time: 5:00 PM to 5:45 PM GMT+1) when it says something new; the server writes only the announced time, so the two always agree. seatsLeft is an optional line of plain text, never a countdown, and at 0 the form closes. Mistakes are said in words once the reader has left a field or pressed the button, and the first one takes focus; sending shows a busy button, and a failed send keeps everything typed and puts focus back on the button. The confirmation says where the details went, states the reminder schedule (pass reminders with what you really send; the default is only a stand-in), says the recording is coming when it was asked for, and offers Add to calendar as a link to a calendar file you supply in calendarHref (a data: URL or an .ics file; a data URL is saved as calendarFileName). defaultStatus done starts on the confirmation. Below 896px, on a phone or a tablet held upright, the form follows the date, before what the reader will learn; from 896px it takes a column of its own beside them. labels translates every fixed word, errors included.
